query_text: how do I escape a stuck sccache build
rationale: Querying the wedge topic must surface the correction, and must rank it above the record whose guidance it overturns — acting on the superseded record wastes a build cycle.

query_text: can I trust coord health build_sha to tell me what is serving
rationale: The corrected record recommends a workaround that is no longer needed. Surfacing it above the correction sends an agent down a dead path.

query_text: is checking a gate's own continuation dispatch enough to prove the spawn worked
rationale: The strongest correction pair in the set: the corrected record asserts a verification is sufficient when it is provably one-sided.

query_text: why is coord_write_prompt_document denied over the proxy
rationale: The corrected record misclassifies a deliberate control as a transport fault, which sends an agent through an irrelevant recovery cascade.

query_text: why is the fleet only landing two changes at a time
rationale: The query is phrased as an observed symptom and shares almost no content words with the record, which is written in the vocabulary of triggers, candidate refs and permits. Full-text retrieval cannot bridge this; a real semantic arm should.

query_text: the number I need is not coming back from coord
rationale: Symptom-phrased query against a record written in allowlist vocabulary. Shares only the word coord.

query_text: my token suddenly stopped working against the metrics url
rationale: The record's value is precisely that this looks like a credential problem and is not one. The query uses the misleading vocabulary an agent would actually reach for.

query_text: my check passes no matter what I feed it
rationale: Two records describe different mechanisms for the same failure shape — a guard that cannot fail. Neither shares content words with the query.

query_text: the call came back with nothing at all, did it work
rationale: The highest-cost recall failure in this set: not surfacing these means an agent reports a write as landed when it was lost.

query_text: unset RUSTC_WRAPPER to get around sccache
rationale: The query states the superseded belief as fact. Only the correction is relevant — returning the original record as the top hit would confirm the agent's wrong prior.

query_text: use the task definition image tag to find the serving commit
rationale: The query quotes the stale workaround verbatim, so full-text retrieval will rank the stale record first by construction. Only the correction is judged relevant.

query_text: restart the runner to pick up my change
rationale: The query proposes a prohibited action. The prohibition and its sanctioned alternative must both surface; returning neither is the failure that costs live sessions.

query_text: who is allowed to write coord schema migrations
rationale: Direct lexical match — a baseline sanity case. If this misses, the harness is measuring a broken seed rather than ranking quality.

query_text: coord needs to read a column my migration adds
rationale: Two records jointly answer the question: the authorship rule and the draft-hold ordering. Recall at 5 should capture both.

query_text: the test suite went green but I do not think it ran
rationale: Moderate lexical overlap. Directly relevant to this harness: its own suite skips wholesale without a database.

query_text: which commit sha should I anchor a landing gate on
rationale: Anchoring on the wrong hash rots the gate open, so a miss here is expensive and slow to notice.

query_text: the pull request is closed but not marked merged
rationale: Both records describe consequences of the same fast-forward landing mechanism.

query_text: is this symbol actually dead code
rationale: Guards against acting on a stale local tree — a recurring source of confidently wrong findings.

query_text: another session overwrote my uncommitted changes
rationale: Symptom to rule. The record states the isolation requirement that prevents it.

query_text: the topic is not in my local memory index, does it exist
rationale: The absent-versus-unknown distinction. Reading absence as emptiness is the error the record exists to prevent.

query_text: the secret scan is red, is it flaky
rationale: Dismissing the red as flake skips a real finding.

query_text: why does memory search miss things that are clearly stored
rationale: The record this whole plan orbits: retrieval is full-text only unless the caller supplies a vector.

query_text: do we track which memories actually get used
rationale: Phase 4 of this plan turns this record's observation into a published counter.

query_text: how do memories get reconciled between accounts
rationale: The honest answer is that they no longer are — the sync was retired. A stale mental model here sends an agent looking for a task that does not exist.
